title: N0 retrained for EG seed 0 with its weights saved, to look inside the LSTM (states, order test).
hypothesis: Shuffling the window order during training should not be what makes the model work; turning it off changes training, not what each window contains.
motivation: Supervisors questioned shuffling windows (torque at t needs earlier samples). Same settings as N0 (final model before calibration), 6 people x 3 seeds, session 1 -> session 2.
